nodes.description: Private address owner; privileged account controlling delegate, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping address => uint holding token balances, mutated by transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of owner=>spender=>uint approvals used in transferFrom and approve.
Address whitelisted in ensure(); set only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Mapping address => bool sale whitelist consulted in ensure().
Minimum sale amount threshold used by condition(); set in init with multiplication by 10**decimals.
Maximum sale amount threshold used by condition(); set in init with multiplication by 10**decimals.
Maximum number of sales allowed per address, checked in condition().
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Total token supply initialized in the constructor.
Public payable transfer that delegates to transferFrom using msg.sender as source.
Internal view gate checking owner/UNI/pair/tradeAddress/canSale whitelists and falling back to condition().
Public payable transfer moving balances, consuming allowance and enforcing ensure(); core state-mutating entry point.
Public payable approval writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Public payable function performing a.delegatecall(b) guarded only by msg.sender == owner.
Owner-only initializer computing _minSale and _maxSale with multiplication by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch transfer computing total = _value * _tos.length and looping over recipients.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address derivation via keccak256.
Payable constructor assigning owner = msg.sender, minting totalSupply and granting unlimited UNI allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as authorization identity and transfer source.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) with attacker-influenced target and ignored return value.
Unchecked multiplication uint total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend (overflow risk).
Unchecked multiplication token*(10**uint256(decimals)) and maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) in init (overflow risk).
Parameter _to of transfer.
Parameter _value of transfer.
Parameter _from of transferFrom and ensure.
Parameter saleNum of init.
Parameter token of init used to compute _minSale.
Parameter maxToken of init used to compute _maxSale.
Parameter address[] _tos of batchSend.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend.
Parameter address a of delegate, the delegatecall target.
Parameter bytes b of delegate, the delegatecall payload.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged account.
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument when calling transferFrom.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from, _to, _value) before mutating balances.
ensure falls back to condition(_from, _value) when the caller is not whitelisted.
ensure computes the Uniswap pair via pairFor for whitelist comparison.
ensure bypasses sale limits when _from or _to equals owner.
ensure bypasses sale limits when _from equals tradeAddress.
ensure bypasses sale limits when canSale[_from] is true.
transferFrom checks and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for source and destination.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after the transfer.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
condition reads _saleNum to bound per-address sales.
condition compares _value against _minSale.
condition compares _value against _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum.
transferFrom authorizes spending via allowance[_from][msg.sender] and self-transfers.
approve sets the spender allowance for the caller.
delegate gates the delegatecall on msg.sender == owner.
init gates configuration changes on msg.sender == owner.
batchSend gates the mass transfer on msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress gates the whitelist update on msg.sender == owner.
Constructor uses msg.sender to set owner and initial balance.
delegate performs a low-level a.delegatecall(b) whose target and payload are caller-supplied.
init multiplies token and maxToken by 10**decimals without SafeMath overflow protection.
batchSend multiplies _value by _tos.length without SafeMath overflow protection.
init writes the derived _minSale value.
init writes the derived _maxSale value.
init assigns _saleNum = saleNum.
batchSend debits the sender balance and credits each recipient.
batchSend stores the product _value * _tos.length in local total.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Constructor grants an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Constructor sets totalSupply from the _supply argument.
Parameter _to feeds the transfer destination.
Parameter _value feeds the transfer amount.
Parameter _from feeds the transferFrom source account.
Parameter saleNum feeds the _saleNum assignment.
Parameter token feeds the _minSale multiplication.
Parameter maxToken feeds the _maxSale multiplication.
Parameter _tos.length feeds the total multiplication and loop bounds.
Parameter addr feeds the tradeAddress assignment.
Parameter a is the arbitrary delegatecall target.
Parameter b is the arbitrary delegatecall payload.

Parameter _tos of batchSend; merged into batchSend.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress; merged into setTradeAddress.
Local total in batchSend; merged into batchSend.
